title: CD / Color
summary: Captain Disillusion's comedic, fast-paced explainer on how color works in cameras, displays and video. It covers the biology of color perception and what it means for screens.
why: Commenters recommend it as a dense but entertaining primer on color theory and color in video systems.

quote.text: I went looking for an understanding of how color works in video systems, and ran across this gem from Captain Disillusion
